images.caption: The Coral Court Motel was a 1941 U.S. Route 66 motel listed on the National Register of Historic Places in St. Louis County in 1989 as an example of the art deco and streamline moderne architectural styles. The classic "no-tell motel" as each unit had its own enclosed garage, it was demolished in 1995 and the land sold for over a million dollars as the site of a suburban housing development.
images.alt: The Coral Court Motel was a 1941 U.S. Route 66 motel listed on the National Register of Historic Places in St. Louis County in 1989 as an example of the art deco and streamline moderne architectural styles. The classic "no-tell motel" as each unit had its own enclosed garage, it was demolished in 1995 and the land sold for over a million dollars as the site of a suburban housing development.
